subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Public art can make people ask what a place should express.”?
options: Reuse showed that large buildings do not have to become empty shells when their first purpose ends.
Fields, greenhouses, rooftops, and warehouses may all become part of feeding cities.
Sometimes a mistake can become an idea if people are willing to look at it differently.
A sculpture may stand silently, but the conversations around it can become part of its purpose.
